calls.title: Motorway + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Motorway is exploring alternatives to Optimizely for their experimentation platform due to limitations in conversion tracking and an upcoming contract renewal around April or May. During the meeting, it was highlighted that Motorway runs 20 to 30 simultaneous experiments and has achieved over 50% year-on-year growth in experimentation velocity. Key challenges involve Optimizely's inability to manage long-term conversions and the need for offline analyses for accurate tracking. Growth Book was presented as a potential alternative, showcasing features such as lightweight SDKs, warehouse integration, and flexible user targeting. The pricing model was discussed, with typical deals in the six-figure range. The meeting concluded with plans for follow-up documentation and internal review.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flags, Data Warehouse Integration, Statistical Methods, Small Sample Size, Visual Editor
